name.ja: BB戦士312 呂蒙ディジェ・甘寧ケンプファー 轟強襲水軍
name.en: BB Senshi 312 Ryomong Dije Ganning Kaempfer Roaring Assault Navy

ja: “呂蒙ディジェ”と“甘寧ケンプファー”が率いる轟強襲水軍がセットになってBB戦士に登場 呂蒙ディジェの“碧斬斧（へきざんふ）”は2つを連結可能 甘寧ケンプファーの武器や鎧は小型メカ“蒼烈鮫（そうれつこう）”に合体 戦闘艇は6形態（戦船形態、楼船形態、強襲形態、甘寧専用強襲形態、呂蒙専用強襲形態、前線基地形態）に組み換え遊びが可能 3体の水軍衆も付属
en: The roaring assault navy led by “Ryomong Dije” and “Ganning Kämpfer” appears in BB Senshi as a set. Ryo Mong Dije’s “Hekizanfu” can be linked together. Ganning Kampfer’s weapons and armor are combined into the small mecha “Souretsukou”. The battle boat can be recombined into 6 forms (battleship form, tower ship form, assault form, Ganning-only assault form, Ryomong-only assault form, and frontline base form). 3 sailors are also included.
